name: Lookbook
summary: Passive container-responsive editorial sequence of ordered target-owned media figures with persistent captions and target-owned native hotspots.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Titled thematic section or untitled generic root for one complete finite editorial sequence.

anatomy.name: title
anatomy.description: Optional visible contextual heading that names the thematic root.

anatomy.name: items
anatomy.description: Required native ordered list and responsive layout region for target-owned cells.

anatomy.name: cell
anatomy.description: Repeated passive native list item containing one complete target-owned media composition.

anatomy.name: wideCell
anatomy.description: Item-level layout modifier that spans two available columns without changing source order.

anatomy.name: tallCell
anatomy.description: Item-level layout modifier that spans two implicit rows without changing source order.

anatomy.name: figure
anatomy.description: Target-owned native figure grouping one media item with its optional persistent caption.

anatomy.name: caption
anatomy.description: Optional persistent native figcaption for one media figure.

anatomy.name: hotspot
anatomy.description: Optional target-owned native link or button positioned over a figure only when a real result exists.

variants.name: default
variants.description: Single editorial sequence; wide and tall are item-level layout modifiers rather than parent variants.

sizes.name: default
sizes.description: Intrinsic size whose private tracks and row geometry respond to component space.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive resting editorial sequence with captions persistently visible.

states.name: targetInteractiveFocus
states.description: Visible keyboard focus only when target-owned native interaction receives focus.

behavior.name: rootSemantics
behavior.description: A non-empty title produces a thematic section named by its visible heading; an untitled composition uses a generic root.

behavior.name: sourceOrder
behavior.description: Native ordered-list order remains authoritative; sparse Grid placement and wide/tall spans never reorder content.

behavior.name: cellLayout
behavior.description: The target assigns each cell's default, wide or tall modifier while neutral CSS owns only private responsive geometry.

behavior.name: itemOwnership
behavior.description: Targets supply complete figure/media/caption content and own sources, dimensions, alternatives, loading, localization and editor data.

behavior.name: captionAvailability
behavior.description: When supplied, a caption remains visually present without hover, focus or pointer capability.

behavior.name: hotspotOwnership
behavior.description: Only a target-owned native link or button may add a hotspot; it owns accessible name, destination or disclosure lifecycle, coordinates, commerce data and analytics.

behavior.name: omission
behavior.description: Missing required items omits the root; an empty optional title omits only the header and selects generic root semantics.

behavior.name: runtimeBoundary
behavior.description: Neutral Web uses no component JavaScript, observer, listener, request, timer, layout measurement, focus manager or authored motion.

properties.name: title
properties.description: Optional non-empty visible contextual heading; when present it names the thematic root.

properties.name: items
properties.description: One or more source-ordered target-owned native list-item compositions including layout modifier, complete media semantics, optional caption and any legitimate native hotspot.

accessibility: When title is present, render a thematic section associated with the visible contextual heading through aria-labelledby; use a generic root when title is absent.
Render the finite curated sequence as native ol/li content and preserve target-authored source order across default, wide and tall layout modifiers without dense placement.

Use native figure/figcaption for captioned fixture media, keep captions persistently visible, and give informative target media contextual alternatives while hiding decorative or redundant media appropriately.
Do not focus, hover-emphasize, click, select or announce passive cells; only target-owned native links or buttons may add activation and visible native focus.
A product link owns its destination and name; a disclosure hotspot composes canonical Popover or a complete target-native equivalent with open state, focus, dismissal and relationship semantics.
Lookbook adds no authored motion or runtime and does not use span, crop, position, color or visual order as the only meaning cue.
Leave native heading rank, media delivery/loading, hotspot coordinates, commerce/provider data, analytics and editor lifecycle with the owning target.

web.notes: Implemented by conditional titled-section semantics, native ordered-list/figure fixture composition, strict required-slot omission, persistent captions, component-responsive sparse Grid CSS and no neutral runtime.

shopify.notes: Merchant-editable section maps optional title and reorderable complete media blocks; an optional product resource becomes a native product-link hotspot with block-owned coordinates and no section runtime.
